title: Security+ Study Materials
summary: The Security+ is the certification that many cybersecurity-interested people earn soon before starting their career. There are many free resources available for this. Prior to my exam, I used Professor Messer's course on YouTube and took notes daily. I recommend creating an Anki deck alongside your notes to study as well. The PBQ questions on the exam can be difficult to prepare for. I will not link it here, but there are many online shadow libraries where you could likely find practice exams.
